context_schema.role_rule: An Aspect may be computational, analytical-condition-represented, or both when the context explicitly permits the role.
context_schema.rt_embedding_rule: A ResolvedRT may enter an Aspect role only when higher_order_rt_embedding is explicitly enabled.

orientation_rules.equality: OrientEqual(o1,o2,C) holds only when both resolve to the same canonical orientation reference within C.
orientation_rules.conflict: OrientConflict(o1,o2,C) holds when the active constraints in C require incompatible orientation assignments.
orientation_rules.incomparability: OrientIncomparable(o1,o2,C) is returned when C lacks an admissible comparison relation; it is not equality or conflict.
orientation_rules.preservation: ComparePreservesOrientation(compare,A,C) requires the comparison output to retain every orientation distinction declared relevant by C.
orientation_rules.selection: No orientation tie-break or canonical selector is defined by this report.

analytical_view_mapping.computational_input_rule: A ConditionView cannot enter MTO as an Aspect unless Ref_A resolves it uniquely in the active context.
analytical_view_mapping.nonreversibility: A non-unique or unavailable Ref_A result is unresolved, not evidence that the view is a distinct Aspect.

open_obligations: Define comparison relation completeness and preservation.
Define conflict precedence when multiple constraints apply.
Define higher-order RT embedding semantics and residue requirements.
nonclaims: No orientation pair is classified equal or conflicting without concrete context data.
No deterministic MTO selection is established.
